body:
FYI: #2613 (BUG-2120, the priority fix that unblocks the night shift) got REQUEST CHANGES in round 1 at 8d5b60d146.

The blocker is a fail-open. A resumed session keeps its session id, so dead-PID registry entries sit next to the live one, and registry_attribution picks one arbitrarily (HashMap/read_dir order). A live polling session can then be cleared. That is the BUG-1589 regression.

The reviewer reproduced it on this machine: 27 multi-entry session ids. The fix is small (count the holder as live if ANY un-ended entry has a live PID, plus a test). Codex has been mailed, and it gets re-reviewed immediately at the new head. Details are on the PR.

Next slot: #2614 (STORY-1687), as you directed.
subject: #2613 BUG-2120 r1 REQUEST CHANGES (fail-open on resumed sessions); #2614 starting
